title: Ensure 'Prevent enabling lock screen camera' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Control Panel\Personalization\Prevent enabling lock screen camera to 'Enabled'
reason: Disabling the lock screen camera extends the protection afforded by the lock screen to camera features.

title: Ensure 'Prevent enabling lock screen slide show' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Control Panel\Personalization\Prevent enabling lock screen slide show to 'Enabled'
reason: Disabling the lock screen slide show extends the protection afforded by the lock screen to slide show contents.

title: Ensure 'Allow users to enable online speech recognition services' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Control Panel\Regional and Language Options\Allow users to enable online speech recognition services to 'Disabled'
reason: If this setting is Enabled sensitive information could be stored in the cloud or sent to Microsoft.

title: Ensure 'Allow Online Tips' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Control Panel\Allow Online Tips to 'Disabled'
reason: In high-security environments, data must never be shared with third-parties without explicit consent, as it may contain sensitive information.

title: Ensure 'Configure SMB v1 client driver' is set to 'Enabled: Disable driver (recommended)'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Configure SMB v1 client driver to 'Enabled: Disable driver (recommended)'
reason: Since September 2016, Microsoft has strongly encouraged that SMBv1 be disabled and no longer used on modern networks, as it is a 30 year old design that is much more vulnerable to attacks then much newer designs such as SMBv2 and SMBv3.

title: Ensure 'Configure SMB v1 server' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Configure SMB v1 server to 'Disabled'
reason: Since September 2016, Microsoft has strongly encouraged that SMBv1 be disabled and no longer used on modern networks, as it is a 30 year old design that is much more vulnerable to attacks then much newer designs such as SMBv2 and SMBv3.

title: Ensure 'Enable Certificate Padding' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Enable Certificate Padding to 'Enabled'
reason: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the WinVerifyTrust function handles Windows Authenticode signature verification for portable executable (PE) files.

title: Ensure 'Enable Structured Exception Handling Overwrite Protection (SEHOP)' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Enable Structured Exception Handling Overwrite Protection (SEHOP) to 'Enabled'
reason: This feature is designed to block exploits that use the Structured Exception Handler (SEH) overwrite technique.

title: Ensure 'NetBT NodeType configuration' is set to 'Enabled: P-node (recommended)'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\NetBT NodeType configuration to 'Enabled: P-node (recommended)'
reason: In order to help mitigate the risk of NetBIOS Name Service (NBT-NS) poisoning attacks, setting the node type to P-node (point-to-point) will prevent the system from sending out NetBIOS broadcasts.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (AutoAdminLogon) Enable Automatic Logon' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (AutoAdminLogon) Enable Automatic Logon to 'Disabled'
reason: If you configure a computer for automatic logon, anyone who can physically gain access to the computer can also gain access to everything that is on the computer, including any network or networks that the computer is connected to. Also, if you enable automatic logon, the password is stored in the registry in plaintext.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (DisableIPSourceRouting IPv6) IP source routing protection level' is set to 'Enabled: Highest protection, source routing is completely disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (DisableIPSourceRouting IPv6) IP source routing protection level to 'Enabled: Highest protection, source routing is completely disabled'
reason: A threat actor could use source routed packets to obscure their identity and location. Source routing allows a computer that sends a packet to specify the route that the packet takes.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (DisableIPSourceRouting) IP source routing protection level' is set to 'Enabled: Highest protection, source routing is completely disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (DisableIPSourceRouting) IP source routing protection level to 'Enabled: Highest protection, source routing is completely disabled'
reason: A threat actor could use source routed packets to obscure their identity and location. Source routing allows a computer that sends a packet to specify the route that the packet takes.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (EnableICMPRedirect) Allow ICMP redirects to override OSPF generated routes' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (EnableICMPRedirect) Allow ICMP redirects to override OSPF generated routes to 'Disabled'
reason: The 10 minute time-out period for the ICMP redirect-plumbed routes temporarily creates a network situation in which traffic will no longer be routed properly for the affected host. Ignoring such ICMP redirects will limit the system's exposure to attacks that will impact its ability to participate on the network.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (KeepAliveTime) How often keep-alive packets are sent in milliseconds' is set to 'Enabled: 300,000 or 5 minutes'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (KeepAliveTime) How often keep-alive packets are sent in milliseconds to 'Enabled: 300,000 or 5 minutes'
reason: A threat actor who is able to connect to network applications could establish numerous connections to cause a DoS condition.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (NoNameReleaseOnDemand) Allow the computer to ignore NetBIOS name release requests except from WINS servers' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (NoNameReleaseOnDemand) Allow the computer to ignore NetBIOS name release requests except from WINS servers to 'Enabled'
reason: The NetBT protocol is designed not to use authentication, and is therefore vulnerable to spoofing. Spoofing makes a transmission appear to come from a user other than the user who performed the action. A threat actor could exploit the unauthenticated nature of the protocol to send a name-conflict datagram to a target computer, which would cause the computer to relinquish its name and not respond to queries.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (PerformRouterDiscovery) Allow IRDP to detect and configure Default Gateway addresses' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (PerformRouterDiscovery) Allow IRDP to detect and configure Default Gateway addresses to 'Disabled'
reason: A threat actor who has gained control of a computer on the same network segment could configure a computer on the network to impersonate a router. Other computers with IRDP enabled would then attempt to route their traffic through the already compromised computer.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (SafeDllSearchMode) Enable Safe DLL search mode' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (SafeDllSearchMode) Enable Safe DLL search mode to 'Enabled'
reason: If a user unknowingly executes hostile code that was packaged with additional files that include modified versions of system DLLs, the hostile code could load its own versions of those DLLs and potentially increase the type and degree of damage the code can render.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (TcpMaxDataRetransmissions IPv6) How many times unacknowledged data is retransmitted' is set to 'Enabled: 3'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS:(TcpMaxDataRetransmissions IPv6) How many times unacknowledged data is retransmitted to 'Enabled: 3'
reason: A threat actor could exhaust a target computer's resources if it never sent any acknowledgment messages for data that was transmitted by the target computer.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (TcpMaxDataRetransmissions) How many times unacknowledged data is retransmitted' is set to 'Enabled: 3'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS:(TcpMaxDataRetransmissions) How many times unacknowledged data is retransmitted to 'Enabled: 3'
reason: A threat actor could exhaust a target computer's resources if it never sent any acknowledgment messages for data that was transmitted by the target computer.

title: Ensure 'MSS: (WarningLevel) Percentage threshold for the security event log at which the system will generate a warning' is set to 'Enabled: 90% or less'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MSS (Legacy)\MSS: (WarningLevel) Percentage threshold for the security event log at which the system will generate a warning to 'Enabled: 90% or less'
reason: If the Security log reaches 90 percent of its capacity and the computer has not been configured to overwrite events as needed, more recent events will not be written to the log. If the log reaches its capacity and the computer has been configured to shut down when it can no longer record events to the Security log, the computer will shut down and will no longer be available to provide network services.
